name: FV_GTAS_ATTRIBUTES_
description: This is an audit table that tracks changes to the FV_GTAS_ATTRIBUTES table

columns.name: GTAS_ATTRIBUTES_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each GTAS attribute.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the ledger.

columns.name: GTAS_NATURAL_ACCOUNT_VALUE
columns.description: The natural account segment value.

columns.name: FISCAL_YEAR
columns.description: Fiscal year of the GTAS reporting attributes.

columns.name: SUMMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the type of natural account that identifies whether it is a parent or child account.

columns.name: BALANCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The code for the GTAS balance type that indicates the type of balance, for example, beginning, ending, and so on.

columns.name: ENABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the GTAS attribute is enabled.

columns.name: AUTHORITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the authority type codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_AUTHORITY_TYPE lookup.

columns.name: APPORTIONMENT_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the apportionment category codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_APPORTIONMENT_CAT_CODE lookup.

columns.name: DIRECT_OR_REIMBURSABLE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the direct or reimbursable codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_DIRECT_OR_REIMBURSEABLE lookup.

columns.name: FEDERAL_NON_FEDERAL_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the federal or non-federal codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_FED_OR_NONFED_CODE lookup.

columns.name: NEW_BALANCE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the new or balance codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_NEW_OR_BAL lookup.

columns.name: CURRENT_SUBSEQUENT_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the current or subsequent codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_CURR_OR_SUBSEQUENT lookup.

columns.name: BEA_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the Budget Enforcement Act (BEA) category codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_BEA_CATEGORY_CODE lookup.

columns.name: BEA_CATEGORY_ACCT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the Budget Enforcement Act (BEA) category account type codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_BEA_CATEGORY_TYPE lookup.

columns.name: BORROWING_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the borrowing source codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_BORROWING_SOURCE lookup.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_NON_EXCHANGE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the exchange or non-exchange codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_EXCHANGE_OR_NO_EXCHANGE lookup.

columns.name: CUST_NON_CUST_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the custodial or non-custodial codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_CUST_OR_NONCUST_CODE lookup.

columns.name: BUDGET_IMPACT_INDICATOR_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the budget impact indicator codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_BUDGT_IMPACT_INDICATOR lookup.

columns.name: PYA_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the prior year adjustment codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_PRIOR_YEAR_ADJUSTMENT lookup.

columns.name: REDUCTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the reduction type codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_REDUCTION_TYPE lookup.

columns.name: DISASTER_EMERGENCY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the disaster emergency fund code is required.

columns.name: TRADING_PARTNER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the trading partner is required.

columns.name: AWARD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the award attribute is required.

columns.name: APPORTIONMENT_CAT_B_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the apportionment category B code is required.

columns.name: PROGRAM_REPORT_CODE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the program reporting category code is required.

columns.name: COHORT_YEAR_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the cohort year is required.

columns.name: TRADING_PARTNER_MAIN_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the trading partner main account is required.

columns.name: BUDGET_OBJECT_CODE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the budget object code is required.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
